Final focused run passed 259 tests; all 18 distinct a/b fault cases were caught with restoration and green restored runs, including both production auth reverts. Four additional baseline/red/restored runs on (a) remain separate from these transport cases. Fixture credentials and census races are not live pairing or adversarial process-load qualification; Windows/Linux, native/remote, hosted and release proof remain absent.
